_comment: Connection-method badge family. Independent of data/statuses.json: a method describes the technical ROUTE to a provider, never whether it is live. 'bakuun' renders as 'Via Bakuun' only when the record's connectionProviderDisclosureApproved is true; otherwise it falls back to 'via-technology-partner'.

direct.definition: KabuK Exchange connects to the provider's system without an intermediary.
direct.use: Only when the technical route is a KBKx-built integration.
direct.avoid: Never as a synonym for Live — pair it with a separately verified status.

bakuun.definition: The connection is routed through Bakuun.
bakuun.use: Only when use of the Bakuun name and the provider association are authorized in writing.
bakuun.avoid: Never to imply the provider is live through KBKx; without naming approval use Via Technology Partner.

label.ja: テクノロジーパートナー経由

other_partner.definition: The connection is routed through an established connectivity partner that is not named publicly.
other_partner.use: Default for any partner-routed connection whose partner name is not approved for disclosure.
other_partner.avoid: Never to hide a direct integration or to imply production availability.
